author: jiachenlei
description:
Overview
	



This dataset contains raw ImageNet training images in JPEG format. 
If you are using it for image generation training and need to report FID score, it's highly recommended to center-crop them into 256/512 and save in PNG format.
You could refer to the codes in this github repo for pre-processing the dataset and evaluating the FID score.

	
		
	
	
		Proper Usage/Citation/License
	

Please refer to the offical repo, which contains parquet files instead of raw images
